Autopsy shows injuries consistent with assault, neck compression, blunt force, causing light injuries (second-degree). She died from drowning, but injuries contributed? Likely homicide (故意杀人) or homicide by negligence? He used violence leading to death. Could be "故意伤害致人死亡" which under Chinese law is "故意伤害罪致人死亡" (i.e., "故意伤害致死罪") which is punishable as homicide. Also "虐待家庭成员罪" (Domestic violence). The prosecution mentions "故意伤害他人，致人轻伤，并虐待家庭成员，情节恶劣，致使被害人死亡". So crimes: "故意伤害致死罪" (or "故意杀人罪"?). Since intent to kill not proven, but caused death by assault, it's "故意伤害致死罪". Also "虐待家庭成员罪". So answer should list both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]故意伤害致死罪;虐待家庭成员罪<eoa>
